rules: Unchanged hypothesis, predictors, 10-second log-midprice-return target, causal sampling, same-session 71-point eligibility and chronological label purging.
scoring: No main-study scoring during collection. Final heavy analysis on a separate machine.
commissioning: All timestamps before the inclusive start are commissioning only. Deliberate restart/crash tests use separate commissioning directories.
missing_data: No price imputation or continuity across gaps or session boundaries. Assembly explicitly marks missing grid seconds invalid; duplicate timestamps are rejected.
readiness: Record a separate readiness decision after restart, backup and external alert verification. If not ready before start, agree a revised prospective window rather than silently shifting dates.
